name: TC-SL-008 — 修改店铺买手弹窗 [P1]
description: 验证修改买手弹窗：可搜索下拉、不能选当前买手、保存后刷新

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row, tbody tr'); for (const row of rows) { const editBuyer = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a, [class*=edit]')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('修改') && b.textContent.includes('买手') || b.getAttribute('aria-label')?.includes('买手')); if (editBuyer) { editBuyer.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, .ant-drawer'); if (!modal) return { found: false }; const currentBuyer = modal.textContent.includes('当前'); const select = modal.querySelector('.ant-select'); const saveBtn = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('保存')); return { found: true, currentBuyer, select: !!select, saveBtn: !!saveBtn }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 存在已分配买手的店铺，用户有修改权限
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 点击修改买手入口
2. 验证弹窗展示当前买手和新买手选择器
3. 选择与当前相同买手验证提示
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 弹窗展示当前买手和可搜索下拉
2. 新买手不能与当前买手相同
3. 保存后刷新列表买手列
4. 历史迭代原买手不被覆盖
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/店铺列表
